name: Josephine R. Heffernan

burial.cemetery: Chapel of the Chimes Columbarium and Mausoleum

bioAdditions: FamilySearch identifies her husband as George Julius Wagner (b. California 27 Jan 1876, d. 1927; WWI draft registration in Alameda Co.), and two daughters, Josephine Eugenia (1909-1976) and Mary Georgia (1911-2008). She was widowed at about 43 and lived another 57 years, in Piedmont, Berkeley and Oakland (S1, S2).
